# nemau_instance (Data Source)

An existing instance, for referencing a machine Terraform does not manage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An instance created outside Terraform.
data "nemau_instance" "bastion" {
  id = "6f1d2c3b-8a4e-4f7d-9b20-5e3c1a7d9f42"
}

output "bastion_addresses" {
  value = data.nemau_instance.bastion.addresses
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Instance id.

### Read-Only

- `addresses` (List of String) Known IP addresses. Empty until the guest has reported its network configuration.
- `disk_gb` (Number) System disk, in GB.
- `key_name` (String) Name of the SSH keypair injected at boot.
- `name` (String) Instance name.
- `ram_mb` (Number) Memory, in MB.
- `status` (String) Reported status: running, stopped, paused or pending.
- `vcpus` (Number) Number of vCPUs.
